summary: The diff implements all three requirements. REQ-1 is addressed by refactoring App.tsx with null guards, role-based routing safety (isPage validator, getDefaultPageForRole), loading states, and graceful actor initialization handling. REQ-2 is fulfilled by the new ErrorBoundary component with app name, error message, and reload button, wrapping app content in App.tsx. REQ-3 is partially addressed by lazy-loading pages in App.tsx with Suspense/PageLoader fallbacks, and SatelliteMapView is lazy-loaded with Suspense in StoreManagementPage. However, QRScanModal and BarcodeScanStep are not lazy-loaded with Suspense boundaries — they are imported directly.

missing_requirements.requirement: All dynamically imported components (SatelliteMapView, QRScanModal, BarcodeScanStep) have Suspense boundaries with loading indicators
missing_requirements.reason: QRScanModal and BarcodeScanStep are not lazy-loaded via React.lazy with Suspense boundaries. They are imported statically in ScanPage.tsx and DistributorWorkflowDialog.tsx respectively. Only SatelliteMapView has the lazy+Suspense pattern applied.
